zeroconf_confirm.description: Do you want to add the Savant {name} thermostat at {host}?

discovery_error.description: Check the controller connection, then submit to retry passive zone discovery.

zone_area.title: Set Up Zone {zone_id}
zone_area.description: Choose a name and optionally select an existing Home Assistant area. Discovery continues while you review zones. Finish now to save all zones found so far; unreviewed zones keep their names without an area. Later zones are added automatically at runtime.

discovery_review.title: Zones Found So Far
discovery_review.description: Found: {zones}. Finish now, or uncheck the box to wait for another zone within the discovery window. Later zones are added automatically at runtime.

progress.discover_zones: Waiting for the next thermostat zone, for up to 40 seconds total. You can review names and areas as zones arrive and finish early. No commands are sent.

error.no_zones: No thermostat zones were received. Check the telemetry host and port and retry.
error.invalid_area: This area no longer exists. Select an existing area or leave it unassigned.

abort.not_cli_device: This device is not a CLI-W200/W220 thermostat
abort.no_ipv4: No reachable IPv4 address was found for this device

connection_failed.message: Failed to connect to the thermostat at {host}:{port}
